units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:5">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>חד בר נש … בק׳</he> a man owed his neighbor one hundred denars on a note; <he>אי לא יהב לך ק׳ וכ׳</he> unless he hand thee the note, give him no money.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="S00599"><he>קוּרְטֵסָא</he></cite> a piece of paper.—Pl. <he>קַרְטִיסַיָּיא</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:11">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>הא ק׳ קדמך וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="K01342"><he>כתבא</he></cite>) the documents (accounts) are before thee, read and count.
